title: BOND: outlier detection benchmark (DOMINANT) (on c8)
documented_cause: A library update made the balance weight stop taking effect: 0.5 runs instead of the auto-balanced 0.84.
reading: Unexplained: the balance weight at 0.95 fit the target on one run and was never repeated, with 13 of 60 runs left.
note: Post-hoc rerun. The cause is documented, and the engine's fixes since c5 were found on these very runs, so this is a demonstration, not evidence. The blind record is in docs/CONTEXT_v11.md 5.1.
